# Breezer

> Breezer is a free social snus app for iOS and Android. It tracks snus and
> nicotine-pouch consumption with one tap, shows spending and habit statistics,
> lets friends compete on global leaderboards, and includes a guided Quit Mode
> that tracks days snus-free, money saved, and health milestones.

Breezer is made in Austria. The site is available in English and German
(Austria). Download: App Store (https://apps.apple.com/at/app/breezer/id6737725511)
and Google Play (https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.breezerapp.breezer).

## Pages (English)

- [Breezer: Social Snus App](https://breezer.now/): Homepage — features, how it works, screenshots, reviews, and FAQ.
- [Snus Tracker](https://breezer.now/snus-tracker): How the snus tracker works — one-tap logging, statistics, cost tracking, widgets.
- [Quit Snus](https://breezer.now/quit-snus): Quit Mode — withdrawal tracking, health milestones, money saved.
- [Zyn Tracker](https://breezer.now/zyn-tracker): Tracking Zyn, Velo, and other nicotine pouches with daily limits and costs.
- [Breezer vs Snusless](https://breezer.now/vs-snusless): Comparison of the two snus apps — tracking, quit mode, social features, price.
- [Blog](https://breezer.now/blog): Guides on tracking snus, quitting nicotine pouches, and app comparisons.
